title: CARD: Diagnosing Belief to Action Routing Failures in Vision Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.20763v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Linear probes and activation steering have uncovered that vision-language models (VLMs) internally represent mental states such as agents' beliefs, knowledge, and intentions. However, it is unclear whether and how these representations are used by downstream predictions along these axes. To close this gap, we introduce Cross-Axis Routing Diagnostic (CARD), which steers activations along one axis while measuring the response of a different axis's prediction. Applied to open-weight VLMs on Relay Chain -- a new cooperative grid-world benchmark we propose -- we diagnose a critical routing failure: models fail to incorporate belief representations into their next action prediction, effectively leaving valuable information about their partners unused.

translated_title: CARD：诊断视觉语言模型中的信念到行动路由失败
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20763v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：线性探针和激活引导已揭示视觉语言模型（VLMs）在内部表示心理状态，如代理的信念、知识和意图。然而，尚不清楚这些表示是否以及如何被下游预测沿这些轴使用。为填补这一空白，我们引入了跨轴路由诊断（CARD），该方法沿一个轴引导激活，同时测量不同轴预测的响应。应用于我们提出的新合作网格世界基准——Relay Chain上的开源权重VLM时，我们诊断出一个关键的路由失败：模型未能将信念表示纳入其下一步行动预测，有效地留下了关于合作伙伴的有价值信息未使用。
tldr: 本文提出CARD诊断方法，发现视觉语言模型在合作任务中未能将内部信念表示用于行动预测，导致关键信息未被利用。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CARD, a diagnostic method revealing that vision-language models fail to route internal belief representations into action predictions in cooperative tasks, leaving critical information unused.
